problems.title: What can be in your tap water
problems.subtitle: City water is treated, but on its way to you it passes through old pipes. Here's what most often ends up in your glass.

chlorine.title: Chlorine
chlorine.text: Left over from disinfection. Dries your skin and spoils tea and coffee.

rust.title: Rust and iron
rust.text: Comes from old pipes. Stains sinks, bathtubs and laundry.

hardness.title: Hardness
hardness.text: Calcium and magnesium salts. Ruin kettles, coffee machines and boilers.

metals.title: Heavy metals
metals.text: Lead, copper, cadmium. They build up in the body over the years.

microplastics.title: Microplastics
microplastics.text: Particles thinner than a hair. Found even in bottled water.

bacteria.title: Bacteria
bacteria.text: Multiply in pipes and tanks. Especially risky for children.

problems.ctaText: Not sure what's in your water? Answer 4 questions and we'll suggest a model.

how.title: Up to five filtration stages in one unit
how.subtitle: Each stage has its own job. Water passes through them in turn and comes out of a separate faucet clean.

stages.title: Sediment filter
stages.text: Traps sand, rust and particles larger than 5 µm. Protects the next stages and extends their life.

stages.title: Softening
stages.text: Ion-exchange resin swaps hardness salts for sodium. Less limescale in your kettle and coffee machine.

stages.title: Activated carbon
stages.text: Coconut carbon removes chlorine, organics, pesticides and odours. Water tastes great.

stages.title: 0.1–0.01 µm membrane
stages.text: A hollow-fibre membrane retains bacteria and microplastics while keeping healthy minerals.

stages.title: Remineralisation
stages.text: A final cartridge adds calcium and magnesium for pleasant, healthy water.

items.q: How often do I change cartridges?
items.a: Every 1–2 months for pitchers and every 6–12 months for under-sink systems, depending on the model and how much water you drink. We can remind you.

items.q: Can I install an under-sink filter myself?
items.a: Yes. It takes 15–30 minutes: all fittings, the faucet and a video guide are included. If you get stuck, a manager will help over the phone or in a messenger.

items.q: Which filter is best for hard water?
items.a: Pick a model with a softening stage: the Rodnik and Laguna pitchers or the Trio Soft and Quartet Comfort systems. The 1-minute quiz will narrow it down.

items.q: Is filtered water safe for children?
items.a: Yes. For baby food we recommend membrane models — Trio Baby, Quartet Ultra or Pro 5 Mineral — which retain bacteria.
Within 30 days of purchase you can return the filter, even if it's installed. Contact us and we'll arrange the return and refund.

items.q: How do delivery and payment work?
items.a: Next day in Moscow, 1–5 days across Russia by courier or to a pick-up point. Pay by card online, via SBP or on delivery. Prices are in roubles.
